summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares MSCI Finland ETF (EFNL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI Finland IMI 25/50 index, a market-cap-weighted index of Finnish all-cap stocks. EFNL was launched on Jan 25, 2012 and is issued by BlackRock.

holdings.infoBox: EFNL is an equity ETF with a total of 38 individual holdings. The top holdings are Nordea Bank Abp stock at 20.13%, Nokia Oyj at 16.19%, Sampo Oyj at 7.37%, UPM-Kymmene Oyj at 4.68%, and Neste Oyj at 4.63%.
